request.prompt: A common raven (Corvus corax), one adult standing on flat ground, side-on neutral pose. Wings folded tight and flat against the flanks, folded primaries reaching nearly to the tail tip; body slim, about one third as wide as long. Heavy deep black bill about as long as the head, strongly curved culmen, a tuft of bristle feathers covering the nostrils on the base of the upper bill. Shaggy, pointed, bearded throat hackles. Flat crown sloping straight into the bill (Roman-nose profile), thick neck. Long graduated wedge-shaped tail, central feathers longest, pointed tip, no notch. Black scaled legs, four toes: three forward, one back, flat on the ground. All-black glossy plumage with visible feather edges. No base, no perch, no rock. Realistic, game-ready, closed, symmetric.
